company.name: KR8 Digitals
company.positioning: KR8 DIGITALS is a multi-disciplinary creative technology and human-capacity company designing websites, brand identities, commercial graphics, video storytelling, SEO ecosystems, and AI automation — while equipping emerging African talent through tuition-free digital training.
company.shortDescription: KR8 DIGITALS builds commercial digital products, brand systems, films, and intelligent automation for ambitious organisations — alongside tuition-free skill academies and creative communities.
company.mission: To design and engineer commercial websites, brands, films, search architectures, and AI systems that earn real business growth, while removing financial barriers to world-class digital education and creative mentorship.
company.vision: To become Africa's defining bridge between executive-grade digital execution for businesses and accessible, career-launching capability for emerging builders, designers, and storytellers.
company.purpose: Whoever you are, whatever you do, we exist because of you — turning ambitious ideas into trusted digital presences for clients, and turning raw curiosity into market-ready mastery for learners.

referrals.headline: You may not have the skill. You have the people.
referrals.lede: Know a school upgrading its website, a hospitality brand launching a campaign, or a founder scaling operations? Introduce them to KR8 DIGITALS. When the invoice is paid, your commission is paid.
terms: Commission is credited once KR8 DIGITALS confirms the referred client invoice has been paid in full.
Every introduction is logged transparently from first inquiry to completed milestone in your referrer dashboard.
Self-referrals or duplicate submissions for existing active negotiations are excluded.
Withdrawals are settled directly by bank transfer once your cleared balance meets the minimum payout threshold.
